_doc: Machine-readable relay state. baton = who is actively working (idle|mac|linux). Only one host works at a time; git push atomicity enforces it. Edited by ledger/relay.py (automation) or the /relay-resume Claude skill (interactive). Task status: todo=ready, blocked=not implemented yet, running, done.

queue.desc: Both machines reproduce frozen Phase-0 baseline (seed 12345) before trusting cross-machine numbers
Ring-entry metering (RING_METER=wrap-follow+merge-meter). Lifts ring gap 65.8->94.8m (G1' PASS) but G3 FAILS: n_battery_dead 123->153 (entry holds -> hover drain); holds +29%. Flag kept, default OFF.

Isolation: RING_WRAP_FOLLOW only (no merge meter). WORSE than A7: gap 76.1m median but min 65.8 (G1' FAIL), n_battery_dead 240 (G3 FAIL, worse), completed 760. Ring-spacing enforcement is a dead end under this demand.

System-optimum marginal-cost tolling (TOLL_MODE, mult 2x). All hard gates PASS (G2/G3/G1' ok) but NO benefit: holds +3.2%, completed +2, max_agents_on_a_lane flat (6), peak_backlog 999 unchanged. Higher mult (6x) also flat / slightly worse battery. Ineffective because binding constraint is launch backlog, not routing. Flag kept, default OFF.

Demand-capacity balancing (launch-slot scheduling by corridor capacity). THE demonstrated lever: A7/A7b/A5 all left peak_backlog=999 untouched -> throughput is launch-backlog-bound, not ring- or routing-bound. Replace n_active<max_concurrent at launch:~1099 with corridor slot/capacity check. Doc A6 (#2), progress.md Phase 2.
Speed-control deconfliction A/B behind SPEED_CONTROL flag (move-loop cap). Lower priority: also a tactical/routing lever, unlikely to move the launch-backlog wall.
